author: elcapitano96
quote: Game is simply disappointment, from GTA franchise we all knew and loved, escapism from real world to woke bs agenda with satanic rituals literally as content in the game. This is far from Grand Theft Auto, this is woke dating simulator. So story is pushing a narrative around doing everything to please a woman who ghosted Jason with his kid, ended up in jail and kid taken away etc. It's just a terrible mess of pushing agenda onto men, you could argue pampering Lucia missions are optional but game CLEARLY leans towards normalizing and accepting everything bad that Lucia represents, and whole story just makes Jason look like gigantic cuck. Trevor would like to have a word with devs. This is biggest flop in gaming history.
